description: Freshet Unused Media on a bakery site with twenty attachments: eight in use through blocks, a raw URL, a featured image and the site icon, twelve used nowhere, landing on Media > Usage with the scan one click away.

options.blogdescription: A media library with twelve files nobody uses

steps.code:
set_permalink_structure('/%postname%/'); $wp_rewrite->flush_rules(false); /** * A PNG built by hand: a tinted field with a vertical shade and a sprinkle of * noise, so the files differ in size the way photographs do. No image library * is needed to write it, only zlib. */ function freshet_preview_png(int $width, int $height, int $seed): string { mt_srand($seed); $base = chr(mt_rand(30, 200)) . chr(mt_rand(30, 200)) . chr(mt_rand(30, 200)); $noise = mt_rand(10, 60); $raw = ''; for ($y = 0; $y < $height; $y++) { $shade = (int) (($y / $height) * 50); $pixel = ''; for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) { $pixel .= chr(min(255, ord($base[$i]) + $shade)); } $row = str_repeat($pixel, $width); for ($n = 0; $n < $noise; $n++) { $at = mt_rand(0, $width - 1) * 3; $row = substr_replace($row, chr(mt_rand(0, 255)) . chr(mt_rand(0, 255)) . chr(mt_rand(0, 255)), $at, 3); } $raw .= "\0" . $row; } $chunk = static function (string $type, string $data): string { return pack('N', strlen($data)) . $type . $data . pack('N', crc32($type . $data)); }; return "\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" . $chunk('IHDR', pack('NNCCCCC', $width, $height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)) . $chunk('IDAT', gzcompress($raw, 6)) . $chunk('IEND', ''); } // Two pages and a post to hang references on. Their content is filled in once // the attachment IDs and URLs exist. $breads_id = (int) wp_insert_post([ 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_title' => 'Our breads', 'post_name' => 'our-breads', 'post_status' => 'publish', ]); $about_id = (int) wp_insert_post([ 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_title' => 'About the bakery', 'post_name' => 'about', 'post_status' => 'publish', ]); $menu_id = (int) wp_insert_post([ 'post_type' => 'post', 'post_title' => 'The autumn menu', 'post_name' => 'autumn-menu', 'post_status' => 'publish', ]); // filename => [title, width, height, uploaded N days ago, "uploaded to" page (0 = none)] $files = [ 'sourdough-loaf.png' => ['Sourdough loaf', 1600, 1067, 210, $breads_id], 'rye-crust.png' => ['Rye crust', 1200, 900, 195, $breads_id], 'baguettes-on-the-rack.png' => ['Baguettes on the rack', 1400, 933, 188, $breads_id], 'morning-pastries.png' => ['Morning pastries', 1024, 768, 160, $menu_id], 'cinnamon-knots.png' => ['Cinnamon knots', 960, 720, 158, $menu_id], 'apple-galette.png' => ['Apple galette', 1280, 853, 151, $menu_id], 'the-shop-front.png' => ['The shop front', 1600, 1200, 300, $about_id], 'bakery-icon.png' => ['Bakery icon', 512, 512, 320, 0], 'flour-sacks.png' => ['Flour sacks', 1200, 800, 140, $breads_id], 'oven-door.png' => ['Oven door', 1024, 683, 132, $breads_id], 'proofing-baskets.png' => ['Proofing baskets', 800, 600, 125, $breads_id], 'wholemeal-loaf-old.png' => ['Wholemeal loaf (old)', 1200, 900, 118, $breads_id], 'seeded-roll.png' => ['Seeded roll', 640, 480, 111, $breads_id], 'hero-banner-v1.png' => ['Hero banner v1', 1920, 640, 260, 0], 'hero-banner-v2.png' => ['Hero banner v2', 1920, 640, 245, 0], 'summer-menu-2019.png' => ['Summer menu 2019', 1000, 1400, 400, 0], 'staff-photo-old.png' => ['Staff photo (old)', 1400, 933, 380, 0], 'market-stall.png' => ['Market stall', 1280, 853, 95, 0], 'delivery-van.png' => ['Delivery van', 1024, 768, 88, 0], 'christmas-stollen.png' => ['Christmas stollen', 900, 900, 70, 0], ]; $upload = wp_upload_dir(); wp_mkdir_p($upload['path']); // Two resized copies per file rather than the theme's full set: enough for the // library to look real, and the seeding stays quick. add_filter('intermediate_image_sizes_advanced', static function (array $sizes): array { return array_intersect_key($sizes, ['thumbnail' => true, 'medium' => true]); }); $ids = []; $urls = []; $seed = 7; foreach ($files as $filename => $file) { list($title, $width, $height, $age_days, $parent) = $file; $path = trailingslashit($upload['path']) . $filename; if (!file_exists($path)) { file_put_contents($path, freshet_preview_png($width, $height, $seed++)); } $uploaded = time() - ($age_days * DAY_IN_SECONDS); $id = wp_insert_attachment([ 'post_mime_type' => 'image/png', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_status' => 'inherit', 'post_parent' => $parent, 'post_date' => gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', $uploaded), 'post_date_gmt' => gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', $uploaded), ], $path, $parent, true); if (is_wp_error($id)) { continue; } wp_update_attachment_metadata((int) $id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata((int) $id, $path)); $ids[$filename] = (int) $id; $urls[$filename] = wp_get_attachment_url((int) $id); } $image_block = static function (string $filename) use ($ids, $urls): string { return sprintf( '', $ids[$filename], esc_url($urls[$filename]) ); }; // Three image blocks: the common case, an ID and a URL in the content. wp_update_post([ 'ID' => $breads_id, 'post_content' => implode("\n", [ '

Three loaves, three image blocks. Every other file uploaded to this page is attached to it in the media library and used nowhere: the scan is what tells those apart.

', $image_block('sourdough-loaf.png'), $image_block('rye-crust.png'), $image_block('baguettes-on-the-rack.png'), ]), ]); // A raw URL in a paragraph and nothing else: no ID, no block attribute. wp_update_post([ 'ID' => $about_id, 'post_content' => sprintf( '

A family bakery on the corner of the market square since 1987. The shop front, photographed the year it opened.

', esc_url($urls['the-shop-front.png']) ), ]); // A gallery block and a featured image. wp_update_post([ 'ID' => $menu_id, 'post_content' => implode("\n", [ '

What is on the counter this season.

', sprintf( '', $image_block('cinnamon-knots.png'), $image_block('apple-galette.png') ), ]), ]); set_post_thumbnail($menu_id, $ids['morning-pastries.png']); // One reference in wp_options: the site icon. update_option('site_icon', $ids['bakery-icon.png']);
